description: The declared account's quotes on the store as a whole (Quote History list): between min and max quotes, in at least N distinct statuses. Outputs: total, count per status, first quote number asc/desc, min/max total. Read only.

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the account that owns the quotes: link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId), never a username. Left out (verification only): any owner

minQuotes.description: Quotes the account must own on the store (at least)

maxQuotes.description: Most quotes allowed, e.g. the page size so all fit one page. Left out: no upper bound

minStatuses.description: Distinct quote statuses the account's quotes must cover (5 when the test filters every status). Left out: any

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)
